notes.notes:

- An attempt to reduce confusion in the final cinematic where it might appear that your choice was incorrect briefly.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 22, 2025

notes.title: Update for April 9, 2025
notes.notes: Just a small one today! This adds a couple extra articles that expands in-game lore. It also has more support for the upcoming translations (FR/ES/DE) that we are working on.

notes.title: Update for April 1st, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New T-Shirt artwork
[*] Now creates a backup before saving game to increase resilience in the event of a hard drive failure
[*] Fixes a bug with the back button not working properly if you visited a result that didn't go in your history
[*] Fixes a bug where if you held the mouse button on the scrollbar in your PC and moved it off the screen, it would become stuck.
[*] Updates some typos on a very obscure article
[*] Fixes a bug with extra pins appearing on the board in Roottreemania
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 31, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes a bug with "Search all Periodicals" where if you changed your keyword the links would stop working.
[*] A non-English search term was only working with a tilde. If you typed it instead of copying and pasting and omitted that accent it didn't work. Now it does!
[*] Added a note to the credits to clarify that no generative AI artwork is used in the Steam version of the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where having a controller plugged in with a particular config option could crash the game
[*] Fixes minimal typos
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for March 24, 2025. Join our Mailing List!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] There's a link to [b][url=https://buttondown.com/eviltrout]sign up to our mailing list[/url][/b] on the main menu. We've started working on something new, and if you're interested in finding out when we have something to announce, the easiest way is to join our email list. We promise not to email you very often!
[*] Fixes an issue where the game could crash while using OBS/Streaming under some circumstances.
[*] Fixed text on a magazine that didn't make sense, given its date.
[*] Fixed some invalid punctuation.
[*] Changed some text that indicated someone was born with an alias, which they weren't.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 21, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where "Search All Periodicals" would miss some Periodicals sometimes in Roottreemania.
- Fixed an incorrect date for a magazine
- Updated the newspaper image to fix a mistake
- Updated a lot of text to clean up punctuation and other mistakes.
- Other typos on evidence and search results

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 11, 2025
notes.notes:
This patch only contains fixes for typos and other text that was incorrect or misleading. 

Thanks to our eagle-eyed investigators for pointing these out!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Mar 3, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]New Rain effects![/b] In Roottreemania, the intro now has a soothing rain visual/audio effect. It will also rain at random times throughout your mystery.
[*] [b]A new music track added![/b] This one is an easter egg.
[*] Fixes an issue where you could lock in an invalid portrait for the final person in The Roottrees are Dead.
[*] Fixed bad cropping of one of the newly updated portraits.
[*] Fixes several more typos. Thanks to our eagle eyed players for hunting them down.
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Febrary 26, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]This update changes the look of The Roottree Sisters (and our logos and key art, etc. - Trailer will be updated soon) The original piece was the first one illustrated for the game, and over the development we learned more about what we wanted the style to look like and got more comfortable working with our artist. Hopefully it's not too weird to swap it out, but I think most people will prefer the new art!
[*]We've added some extra clues and minor artwork changes to differentiate between two siblings that people had trouble with.
[*]There's a new visual clue in a couple pieces of art to help identify a family member who appears in a group photo.
[*]Also, some other minor visual touch ups to a few other pieces of art.
[*]Fixes a typo in a series of adventure novels
[*]More tweaks to allow for game translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 24, 2025
notes.notes:
- FIX: Uses a new approach to temporary files to hopefully make save files more robust when using aggressive virus scanners
- FIX: Uses more complete Godot builds which might help compatibility for some people.
- FIX: Cursor keys moved between evidence when in the notebook and editing text.
- FIX: Pressing a button on the main menu in 16:10 had a black box behind it
- UX: More tweaks for non-English language support
- Fixes one "occurence" of a typo. Get it? It should have been "occurrence."

notes.title: Update Notes for February 20, 2025
notes.notes:
- This build adds some safety to game threading code, to try and help out with an issue that some players are having where their saves are corrupted.
- It also contains some basic scaffolding for other language support (coming soon!)
- Finally, fixes exactly 1 typo.

notes.title: Update Notes for February 17, 2025
notes.notes:
Just a small update today with some small fixes.

[list]
[*] Removed some background details from a couple illustrations in Roottreemania that brought dates into question.
[*] Improved the game's Danish by adding a ø - if this didn't count as a typo there would be none!
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would turn to the hourglass while changing settings
[*] Fixed a bug where you could swap extra portraits for prefilled family tree entries in Roottreemania, and end up with a locked in ? icon. Now you can't do that anymore (it was the easiest fix.)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 13, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: You can now add up to 20 pages in your notebook. It turns out some of our players are [i]absolutely sickos[/i] for note taking and I wanted to enable that behavior.
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: You can choose the locked in portrait for a person. Click on an extra portrait and it'll swap.
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: You can now search Periodicals from the pop-up menu in the browser, evidence, or notebook. By default, this will pre-fill the "Keywords" box with what you highlighted and allow you to choose the periodical from the dropdown to search it. If you have "Search All" Periodicals enabled, though, it will automatically do that.
[*] [b]UX[/b]: Copy was missing from the notebook popup menu. It's in there now.
[*] [b]UX[/b]: Slightly nicer formatting for checkboxes that have descriptions in settings.
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: On a 16:10 screen, with the notebook open, the PC screen was cut off somewhat.
[*] And, of course...
[/list]
[i]There once was a writer so keen,
Whose fingers were quick and lean,
But try as he might,
Many words weren't right,
Typos danced all over the screen![/i]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 11, 2025
notes.notes:
- New setting to enable searching "All Periodicals": This is a much requested feature but also makes some puzzles easier, so it is defaulted to off. Players who find it frustrating to search every periodical for the same thing can turn it on and search much faster.
- New setting to disable intuition: This is a for hardcore detectives who want no leads at all. It's default off.
- Settings has now been split into several screens. It was too much to fit on one screen!
- Fixed a bug where the Newspaper on the title screen looked bad on a 16:10 screen.
- Fixed a bug where the Zoom +/- buttons were visible during cutscenes.
- Would this [i]even be an update[/i] without any typo fixes?

notes.title: Update Notes for February 7, 2025
notes.notes:
- The game now supports 16:10 screens like the one on the Steam Deck. Previously there were black bars at the top and the bottom of the screen but now it should take up the full screen.
- There are performance improvements when zoomed in on the tree, desk or PC.
- Everything you can interact with in the room now has an icon
- Fixes an issue where the zoom buttons were visible on the family tree in cut scenes
- The mouse cursor is smaller on lower resolutions. Previously it looked quite big in 1080p!
- Some small typos were fixed
- A hint is now skipped if you've figured out a later step.
- Fixed an issue where an article would not end up in your history (ghost article?!?!)
- More dates and text have been adjusted to be consistent.

notes.title: Update Notes for February 2, 2025
notes.notes:
This update mostly fixes regressions introduced by other fixes and backend work to support more platforms 😳 - sorry, it's been a busy time!

- Fixes an issue with line spacing of some fonts on the family tree
- Adds back a missing hint in Roottreemania
- No typos this time, but this update includes some minor text changes that make things more clear

notes.title: Update Notes for January 29, 2025
notes.notes:
- Added a List of Names to make it clear your employer provided you with the list. Some players felt like it was cheating to use the list of names. It's not!
- Adds 2 more notebook pages for those who love to take notes.
- Adds an accessibility option to skip motion transitions when moving around the room. It's also skipped now for all players between the tree/pc/evidence because it feels much better.
- There are keyboard shortcuts now for moving around the room (hover over the menu to see, it's the F keys)
- Fixes a bug with some font line spacing
- Fixes typos (insert joke here)

notes.title: Update Notes for January 27, 2025
notes.notes:
- Added a note to the end of the first game to make what you have to do to lock in more clear
- Added an accessibility option for reading font size (Small/Medium/Large/Extra Large)
- Added a Compatibility option when launching the game on Windows that people whose graphics cards aren't working can try.
- Can you believe there's still more typos and text to fix??? Well there are.
- Fix an issue where someone wouldn't be locked in after you beat the base game
- Fixed an issue getting a certain achievement while in Roottreemania.
- Fixed an issue where you could get an achievement at the end of Roottreemania prematurely.

notes.title: Update Notes for January 24, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixes a bug where photos on the family tree would be black
- Adds supports for some missing characters to the notebook font
- Fixes more typos and some other small changes to articles.
- Text changes thanks to helpful Brazilians
- Adds a "Save Note" button to the notebook to make it more clear you should save your notes

notes.title: Update Notes for January 20, 2025
notes.notes:
- The game is more resilient if it crashes during a cut scene. It will fix itself next time you load it.
- Even more typos fixed
- Fixed dates that didn't make sense
- Fixes bugs for display/ui if found find one piece of evidence from a collection separately
- Fixes odd shadow on the wall

notes.title: Update Notes for January 19, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixes the splash image not showing up on a Mac
- Now displays critical errors in pop up menus rather than crashing out to allow easier debugging.
- More typos
- Some dates that didn't make sense were corrected.
- Now says "Exit to SteamOS" on a Steam Deck instead of "Exit to Linux"

notes.title: Update Notes for January 18, 2025
notes.notes:
- Windows mode should center by default to avoid losing the title bar
- Resolution is no longer an option for full screen because in Godot it doesn't do anything and it was causing bugs (You can use the resolution scaling instead.)
- You can view the ending of the base Roottrees are Dead again by clicking "I'm Ready"
- Fixes a bug where the main menu could pop up on top of gameplay
- Uses the proper system temporary file directory rather than the Godot user dir
- Added a missing thing that can help in the ending of Roottremania
- Fixed the dates of The Notorious Montjoys
- Things near the end of Roottreemania are sorted better
- In Roottreemania the goal is now "Key Relatives" instead of "Blood Relatives" because not everyone you lock in is Blood.
- Fixed a bug where a hint might occasionally not show up near the end of Roottreemania
- Fixes more typos

notes.title: Update for January 17, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixes a bug where using the keyboard on the tree could overwrite a selection you had elsewhere
- Uses less VRAM, which should compatibility on older computers
- Fixes a couple typos
- Fixes a bug where a click noise could play endlessly after a mini game
- Fixes a bug where TV subtitles could keep displaying after the cut scene

notes.title: Update Notes for January 16, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixes an issue where you couldn't re-watch the ending of "Roottreemania"
- Adds FPS Cap option to settings
- Fixes a couple typos
- Improves a hint
- Fixes the boot computer image not showing
